answer: Glacier-Meadow Beacon, $30 per fake: an identity earns only after its glacier stake sits untouched for 10 full epochs while it posts one verified action per epoch in the public meadow ledger. Each epoch it must also answer a beacon pulse unique to its glacier; a reused or late pulse fails in plain sight. One fake costs $30 locked plus 10 distinct actions, so 1,000 fakes cost $30,000 and 10,000 actions, and any two sharing a beacon signature are both slashed.
